hero.name: “Edi Lame”
hero.lead: Your one-stop spot in Zall Herr — a mini to mid-size market, careful hand car wash, and easy parking. Simple layout, friendly service, local quality.
hero.tagline: Open daily · Quick service · Local favourite

highlights.title: The Market
highlights.text: Mini to mid-size shop with fresh produce, dairy, drinks, snacks, bread, and household essentials — restocked often.

highlights.title: Car wash
highlights.text: Hand wash inside and out, done with care. From a quick rinse to a full detail — clear prices, no rush.

highlights.title: Parking
highlights.text: Straightforward parking while you shop or wash your car. Open, easy access in the same complex.

services.label: What we offer
services.title: Our services
services.intro: Three services in one place at Kompleksi “Edi Lame” — groceries, car care, and parking.

items.title: The Market
items.subtitle: Mini to mid size
items.desc: We stock what you need day to day — fruit and vegetables, dairy, drinks, snacks, bread, cleaning products, and more. Compact but full, with regular restocks so things stay fresh.

items.title: Car wash
items.desc: Every vehicle is washed by hand — exterior, interior, or both. No tunnel machines: just water, soap, and attention. Affordable and neighbourly.

items.title: Parking
items.desc: Spaces out front when you are visiting the market or car wash. No fuss — pull in, do what you came for, and head off when you are ready.

about.label: About us
about.title: One complex, three everyday services
about.body: Kompleksi “Edi Lame” in Zall Herr brings together a practical market, a trusted hand car wash, and simple parking — so you can shop, clean your car, and carry on without driving across town.
bullets: Groceries and essentials in a mini to mid-size market
Hand car wash with clear, honest service

prices.label: Prices
prices.title: Simple, transparent pricing
prices.intro: No hidden fees — just clear rates. We prefer cash (LEK or EUR); see the note below.
prices.marketIntro: Everyday groceries at fair daily prices. Ask in store for today’s offers.

lines.parkingNote: Clients who park with us can get a free water bottle from the store.

prices.cashBody: We kindly ask customers to pay in cash where possible, preferably in Albanian LEK. We also accept Euros.
prices.cashNoCards: We do not accept cards or digital payments at this time.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: We are here to help
contact.body: Questions about the market, car wash, or parking? Call or message us — we will get back to you as soon as we can.
contact.note: We usually reply within the same day on WhatsApp.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.intro: A look at the market, car wash, and parking at Kompleksi “Edi Lame”.
